title: Fixed Hinged Twin Lattice and Long Grip Grilling Basket
description: One newly authored complete empty static grilling-basket-inspired hand tool. A broad low rectangular lower basket and its whole opposing upper basket each have a real connected open lattice floor, low continuous edge rim and open side cells. The upper half is fixed raised about the shared rear transverse hinge, not a second loose basket. Each half carries a complete long paired-rod handle ending in a blank chamfered brown grip. The lower lattice underside is grounded and the raised half remains attached through the single hinge pin and collars. All numeric geometry is newly authored; no fryer insert, racket head, landing net or old mesh is imported or extracted. This is a complete shallow hinged enclosure with two attached handles rather than a deep single basket suspended inside an electrical well, or an oval flat sporting lattice on one handle. Three constant opaque untextured PBR materials, metres Z up and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One model and zero scenes, not two models or separate grips counted as assets. Empty static art only: no fish, food, fire, coals, heat source, cooking, clamping, latching, hinge movement, food contact, temperature resistance, ergonomics, manufacture, strength or safety capability. No rig animation or interaction.
